skill_name: Explain why Pavlovian conditioning does not always work.
workflow: Pavlovian conditioning does not always work because learning is a complex and unpredictable process, and the desired response from an individual or animal may not be reliably achieved. In addition, the environment and context in which the person or animal is situated can influence how they react to the stimuli, and further complicate achieving a desired response.
